# Third Party

## Dear ImGui

Clone before building:

```bat
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/ocornut/imgui.git third_party/imgui
```

Or download the docking branch if you want docking/viewports later.

Required files used by UberDelivery:
- imgui.cpp / imgui.h
- imgui_draw.cpp
- imgui_tables.cpp
- imgui_widgets.cpp
- backends/imgui_impl_win32.cpp
- backends/imgui_impl_dx11.cpp
